senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; v. צְוֵי II, filthy matter, excrement. Pesik. Dibré, p. 111ᵃ (ref. to צֵא, Is. XXX, 22) צ׳ תאמר לו call it (the idol) filth; Yalk. Lam. 998; Yalk. Prov. 932 (v. צאה).
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 25a:12">Ib. 25ᵃ</cite> <he>פי חזיר כצ׳ וכ׳</he> the mouth of a swine is like moving filth (you must not pray in its sight).
<cite ref="Bekhorot 29b:9">Bekh. 29ᵇ</cite> <he>מלובן מצוֹאָתוֹ</he> wool cleansed of its dirt; a. fr.
